raw.rationale: LY2228820 is a potent p38 MAPK inhibitor with broad antiproliferative activity but little evidence of lineage-selective killing at 2.5 µM; PRISM single-dose screens typically show few selective lineages, and p38 dependency is not strongly restricted to any one lineage. Thus probabilities are low and near the base rate, with slight elevation for lineages where p38/MAPK14 signaling or inflammatory/secretory dependencies are more prominent.
